notes.title: 1.2 Release
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Removed the Steam Input option from the game menu. Steam Input will be on unless you have it set Forced off in the Steam client.
[*] Removed some delays when ending a game or showing the game over message for a school.
[*] Added an additional game mode, Plankton & Fish.
[*] Added a gameplay option to disable AI on schools without human players.
[*] Added the ability for players to join an active game.
[*] Small bug fixes in game menu.
[/list]

notes.title: Beta channel available
notes.content:
To enroll in beta builds, go to the game properties in the Steam client and click the BETAS tab. Select beta from the dropdown menu. No beta access code is required.

Current updates as of v1.2.212:
[list]
[*] Removed the [b]Steam Input[/b] option from the game menu. Steam Input will be on unless you have it set [b]Forced off[/b] in the Steam client.
[*] Renamed [b]Plankton only[/b] game mode to [b]Plankton & Fish[/b]. This mode includes player fish schools, wave fish schools, and plankton.
[*] Added [b]Plankton only[/b] mode. This mode has player fish schools and plankton.
[*] Small bug fixes in game menu.
[/list]

More to come!

notes.title: 1.1 Release
notes.content:
Changes include:
[list]
[*] Improved game balance
[*] New modes of gameplay
[*] Improved performance on higher levels
[/list]
Use the Reset option in the main menu to load changes to default school options. This will improve the game balance.

Go to [b]Gameplay->Game mode[/b] to select one of the following game modes:
[list]
[*] [b]School vs. School[/b] - Original gameplay of each school against the other.
[*] [b]Schools vs. Critters[/b] - All schools collaborate to kill waves of critters.
[*] [b]Plankton only[/b] - Like School vs. School but simpler. No power ups or critters except plankton.
[*] [b]Color balance test[/b] - The game will play all schools automatically and keep track of the winning school each round. Used for testing game balance.
[/list]
